name: Swing Racer
author: theCyberStallion
description: Swing racer is a game about swinging, grappling and bouncing your way to the finish as fast as you can. Control a block using [controls] and race to the end! This is a game I've been working on for a while. I started it when i was new with unity, and now I've picked it back up 2 years later and redid all the code and improved the visuals.
